Ledger Connect Kit Supply Chain Attack

Target: ledger-connect-kit
Repository: https://github.com/LedgerHQ/connect-kit
Date: 2023-12-14
Attribution: Third Party
Component: Library
Language: JavaScript
Cause: Compromised Account/Credentials
Motive: Financial gain
Transitive: true
Impact Type: Financial Exploitation
User Impact: 500000
Domain: npmjs.com (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

A former Ledger employee fell victim to a phishing attack, allowing attackers to access their NPM account and publish malicious versions of the @ledgerhq/connect-kit package. The payload contained a drainer that rerouted cryptocurrency funds to the attacker, affecting major dApps like SushiSwap and Revoke.cash.

Compromised Versions

  • 1.1.5
  • 1.1.6
  • 1.1.7

References

  • https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2023-49954
